title: ネットワークとセキュリティ演習
subtitle: Network and Security Laboratory
educationalGoal:
In this course, students will:
(1) Learn practical techniques related to information networks and information security through programming exercises.
(2) Learn how to program TCP sockets and application protocols.
(3) Learn how to program cryptography and authentication.
advice:
This is a course in which students will learn programming techniques related to information network technology and information security technology.

We will cover the following materials:
 - C programming on Linux
 - Network program mechanism
 - TCP socket
 - Application layer protocols
 - Network programming
 - Cryptographic programming
 - Hash programming
 - Authentication programming
 - Creating application programs

activityGoals.body: Be able to create network programs using TCP sockets.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Be able to fully understand and explain an overview of network programming and security programming.
(2) Be able to fully understand and use basic network technology programming techniques.
(3) Be able to fully understand and use standard cryptographic programming techniques.
(4) Be able to fully understand and use standard authentication technology programming techniques.
(5) Be able to create an original program that applies network and security technologies.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Be able to understand and explain an overview of network programming and security programming.
(2) Be able to understand and use basic network technology programming techniques.
(3) Be able to understand and use standard cryptographic programming techniques.
(4) Be able to understand and use standard authentication programming techniques.
(5) Be able to create an original program that combines network and security technologies.
